t1.text: E11 Console for Mac — today's Mac sidebar, Apple's toolbar, the website inside restyled for the Mac

s3.text:
Decided (Haris 2026-11-14 23:26–23:46, 2026-11-15 09:31): E11 Console for Mac is NOT rebuilt fully native. It stays the website in a window:

THE SIDEBAR — EXACTLY AS TODAY'S MAC APP (Haris 09:31: "sidebar will remain exactly as now"): mac/swift/Sidebar.swift unchanged — the floating glass panel, the window's buttons and the round theme · New task · collapse buttons at its top, the page's rows (Home · Inbox · E11 Day · My Tasks · Content plans · Clients + · Library: Client Assets, Finance, Trash) with their counts, you, Synced, © E11 Agency.

APPLE'S, NEW: the toolbar beside it (the page's name, Talk with its count, Search tasks ⌘K, the E11 mark as today) · right-click menus (only the row's existing actions) · Quick Look. New Task and light / dark stay in the sidebar, so they're not in the toolbar.

THE WEBSITE INSIDE, restyled for the Mac only: the smoother text (Haris 10:49 "i love the smoothest one") — semibold not bold, Apple's own letter spacing, softer text in dark, a little more room between lines, the Mac's own smoothing; Apple's font, Mac table rows, Mac fields / buttons, light / dark with the Mac. Home always one complete page, filling the window, both columns ending on one line — and scrolled to its end, the page's last cards end on the same line as the sidebar's bottom (8 from the window's edge, Haris 10:51), on every page.

E11 Talk for Mac stays fully native.

s4.text:
Home checked against the website again (home.js viewLead, Admin): nothing left out — now on the boards: E11 Day and + New task beside the greeting, the chart's running line, Busiest day and dates, Recent activity (Open Inbox), Checklist, Team on time. (An AM sees the same page with its own words: "Your tasks due today", "Your clients' tasks", "My clients".)

THE OTHER HOME (H3 / H4) — Production, Social and everyone else (home.js viewMember), everything on it: the date · their role, My Day and + New task (only if they can make tasks) · Up next (its chips, Submit files for review — or Mark my part done, or With the CD for review — Open task, Next task → 1 of 5, its checklist) · My pipeline (lanes by Task Update, the one picked listed below) · My week (due and starts, grey = done) · Recent activity (their Inbox) · My CD reviews · Amendments to fix · Latest files · On-time streak. Their sidebar: My Day, no Finance (as today's).

WHAT THE iPHONE HAS AND THE MAC DOESN'T (Home, both kinds):
— Due date…, Trash and Attach Files: now on the Mac's right-click (Haris 10:36).
— A task row's CD chip, Urgent / P1 tag and the overdue row's faint red: now on the Mac's rows too (Haris 10:41; H1 / H2).
— Search finding people, and where each was found: now on the Mac's search (Haris 10:41; shown open on H2).
— Left as it is (Haris 10:41): the iPhone's Home is E11 Day itself; on the Mac E11 Day is its own page.

RIGHT-CLICK (Haris 10:33 "i like it"): Apple's own menu on a task in the Mac app; the website draws its own in browsers — the same choices from one list: Open Task · Status › · Mark Complete · Due Date… · Attach Files… · Copy Link · Trash.

s5.text:
OFFICE ADMIN HOME (H5 / H6) — office.js, everything on it: the date · Office Admin, the greeting · Search Client Assets in the toolbar where everyone's search is, ⌘K (Haris 11:02 — the website has it on the page; same search: every word, client / folder / file names, file types, small typos) · four tiles (Clients in Client Assets, Unread in your Inbox, Team members → the Team page, Claims to approve — only with Finance access) · three boxes the same height down to the window's bottom, each scrolling inside: Latest in Client Assets (client chips, a file opened shows Added by / Added / Size / Folder, Open folder, Download) · Inbox (Unread / All — All when nothing is unread, Mark all read) · Finance · the month (Claims: the bar, submitted / HR approved / paid, the total, HR approve / Mark paid for Finance Admins; Expenses: the month's total and records; Open Dashboard, All reimbursements). Without Finance access: no fourth tile and no Finance box.
Their sidebar as today's: Home, Inbox, Finance (Dashboard, Clients, Reimbursements, Expenses), Library (Client Assets, Trash) — no task pages, no clients list, no New task; its toolbar search is Search Client Assets.
Amounts: the dirham sign in the app (shown as AED here — the board's font doesn't have it).

WHAT THE iPHONE HAS AND THE MAC DOESN'T (Office Admin Home): all five now on the Mac (Haris 11:04):
1. The month — November ⌃⌄, Apple's pop-up button: the last 12 months.
2. Paid On… — a date to pick (today first), in place of Mark paid.
3. ••• — Mark All HR Approved · Set All Paid On… (Finance Admins; shown open on H5).
4. A claim right-clicked (the iPhone's swipes): Open Claim · HR Approved · Paid On… · Share PDF (shown on H6).
5. Need HR approval and HR approved and paid as their own groups with See All; Claims to approve opens Claims.

s6.text:
THE SIDEBAR AS CLAUDE'S — for Haris to approve (2026-11-15 13:20). Mock-up first; the sidebar is locked, so nothing changes in the app until he says yes.

• Shown (S1, S4): edge to edge, as built in the trial — everything inside where it was.
• Its top row: the window's buttons · the sidebar button and the ‹ › arrows drawn as Claude's (Haris 13:26) (the page's back / forward, moved here from the page's top bar) · on the right, light / dark as two buttons side by side (as Claude's pair). New Task is dropped from the sidebar (still + New task on Home, and ⌘N).
• Hidden (S2): the sidebar button hides it completely — the page is the whole window wide; the window's buttons, the sidebar button and ‹ › stay over the page's top-left.
• Peek (S3): hidden, the pointer on the sidebar button (or the window's left edge) shows it over the page, edge to edge as Claude's (Haris 13:26); it goes when the pointer leaves it; clicking the button keeps it shown again.
• Replaces today's slim icon strip (collapsed).
